## Objective
What must be true when this is done, in one or two sentences. Not how.

## Acceptance criteria
- One checkable statement per line.

## Stages
- [ ] One small unit of work that leaves tests green and is committed; name the files it touches and how it is verified.

## Context
- Module docs, ADRs and paths to read. Only the ones that are actually needed.

## Not included
- What a reader would reasonably assume is in scope and is not, with the issue that owns it.

## Dependencies
none

## Definition of done
Tests, docs and the commit/PR this lands as.
